hymns.name_en: What Was Witnessed in the Heavens?
hymns.name_pt: O Que Vimos Lá nos Céus

hymns.name_en: Sweet Is the Peace the Gospel Brings
I Saw a Mighty Angel Fly
What Glorious Scenes Mine Eyes Behold
Awake, Ye Saints of God, Awake!
The Voice of God Again Is Heard
We Thank Thee, O God, for a Prophet
hymns.name_pt: Graças Damos, Ó Deus, Por um Profeta

hymns.name_en: God of Power, God of Right
Come, Listen to a Prophet’s Voice
We Listen to a Prophet’s Voice
Now We’ll Sing with One Accord
A Poor Wayfaring Man of Grief
O God, Our Help in Ages Past
The Happy Day at Last Has Come
For the Strength of the Hills
They, the Builders of the Nation
The Wintry Day, Descending to Its Close
Come, All Ye Saints of Zion
Let Zion in Her Beauty Rise
Hail to the Brightness of Zion’s Glad Morning!
Glorious Things of Thee Are Spoken
Glorious Things Are Sung of Zion
Come, Thou Glorious Day of Promise
Behold, the Mountain of the Lord
We’re Not Ashamed to Own Our Lord
Come, Ye Children of the Lord
Come, O Thou King of Kings
Raise Your Voices to the Lord
All Creatures of Our God and King
On This Day of Joy and Gladness
Come, All Ye Saints Who Dwell on Earth
hymns.name_pt: Ó Santos, Que na Terra Habitais

hymns.name_en: A Mighty Fortress Is Our God
Praise to the Lord, the Almighty
Praise the Lord with Heart and Voice
God of Our Fathers, We Come unto Thee
God of Our Fathers, Whose Almighty Hand
With All the Power of Heart and Tongue
God of Our Fathers, Known of Old
Guide Us, O Thou Great Jehovah
Great God, Attend While Zion Sings
From All That Dwell below the Skies
Father, Thy Children to Thee Now Raise
For the Beauty of the Earth
Now Thank We All Our God
Dearest Children, God Is Near You
The Lord My Pasture Will Prepare
Cast Thy Burden upon the Lord
Come, We That Love the Lord
hymns.name_pt: Ó Vós Que Amais ao Senhor

hymns.name_en: I’m a Pilgrim, I’m a Stranger
Oh, May My Soul Commune with Thee
How Long, O Lord Most Holy and True
Where Can I Turn for Peace?
God Is in His Holy Temple
I Know That My Redeemer Lives
hymns.name_pt: Eu Sei Que Vive Meu Senhor

hymns.name_en: Jesus, the Very Thought of Thee
hymns.name_pt: Só por em Ti, Jesus, Pensar

hymns.name_en: Prayer Is the Soul’s Sincere Desire
As the Dew from Heaven Distilling
O Thou Kind and Gracious Father
God Be with You Till We Meet Again
Lord, We Ask Thee Ere We Part
Father, This Hour Has Been One of Joy
We Have Partaken of Thy Love
Thy Spirit, Lord, Has Stirred Our Souls
Before Thee, Lord, I Bow My Head
Softly Now the Light of Day
Lord, We Come before Thee Now
Lord, Dismiss Us with Thy Blessing
Great God, to Thee My Evening Song

hymns.name_pt: É Tarde, a Noite Logo Vem

hymns.name_en: Come, Let Us Sing an Evening Hymn
As Now We Take the Sacrament
God, Our Father, Hear Us Pray
While of These Emblems We Partake
While of These Emblems We Partake
’Tis Sweet to Sing the Matchless Love
’Tis Sweet to Sing the Matchless Love
Father in Heaven, We Do Believe
Jesus of Nazareth, Savior and King
hymns.name_pt: Jesus de Nazaré, Mestre e Rei

hymns.name_en: We’ll Sing All Hail to Jesus’ Name
Again We Meet around the Board
God Loved Us, So He Sent His Son
hymns.name_pt: Deus Tal Amor por Nós Mostrou

hymns.name_en: Thy Will, O Lord, Be Done
O Thou, Before the World Began
He Died! The Great Redeemer Died
There Is a Green Hill Far Away
How Great the Wisdom and the Love
O Savior, Thou Who Wearest a Crown
Christ the Lord Is Risen Today
Angels We Have Heard on High
It Came upon the Midnight Clear
Far, Far Away on Judea’s Plains
hymns.name_pt: Lá na Judéia, Onde Cristo Nasceu

hymns.name_en: I Heard the Bells on Christmas Day
We Give Thee But Thine Own
Because I Have Been Given Much
Dear to the Heart of the Shepherd
Hear Thou Our Hymn, O Lord
I Have Work Enough to Do
We Are Marching On to Glory
There Is Sunshine in My Soul Today
hymns.name_pt: Minha Alma Hoje Tem a luz

hymns.name_en: You Can Make the Pathway Bright
hymns.name_pt: Deixa a Luz do Sol Entrar

hymns.name_en: Let Us Oft Speak Kind Words
Should You Feel Inclined to Censure
Behold Thy Sons and Daughters, Lord
hymns.name_pt: Eis os Teus Filhos, Ó Senhor
Faze o Bem, Escolhendo o Que É Certo

hymns.name_en: Know This, That Every Soul Is Free
Praise God, from Whom All Blessings Flow
This House We Dedicate to Thee
We Love Thy House, O God
Up, Awake, Ye Defenders of Zion
Put Your Shoulder to the Wheel
As Zion’s Youth in Latter Days
Rejoice! A Glorious Sound Is Heard
O Thou Rock of Our Salvation

hymns.name_pt: Ó Quão Majestosa É a Obra de Deus

hymns.name_en: Come, All Whose Souls Are Lighted
Jehovah, Lord of Heaven and Earth
I’ll Go Where You Want Me to Go
Oh, Holy Words of Truth and Love
Men Are That They Might Have Joy
hymns.name_pt: Do Pó Nos Fala uma Voz

hymns.name_en: Come Away to the Sunday School
As I Search the Holy Scriptures
We Meet Again in Sabbath School
The Glorious Gospel Light Has Shone
If You Could Hie to Kolob
God Moves in a Mysterious Way
Oh, What Songs of the Heart
Rise, Ye Saints, and Temples Enter
Rejoice, Ye Saints of Latter Days
Each Life That Touches Ours for Good
hymns.name_pt: Sempre Que Alguém Nos Faz o Bem

hymns.name_en: O Love That Glorifies the Son
From Homes of Saints Glad Songs Arise
Home Can Be a Heaven on Earth
hymns.name_pt: Pode o Lar Ser Como o Céu

hymns.name_en: I Am a Child of God
Teach Me to Walk in the Light
A Key Was Turned in Latter Days (Women)
Jesus, the Very Thought of Thee (Women)
Ye Who Are Called to Labor (Men)
Come, All Ye Sons of God (Men)
Rise Up, O Men of God (Men’s Choir)
Rise Up, O Men of God (Men)
See the Mighty Priesthood Gathered (Men’s Choir)
Go, Ye Messengers of Heaven (Men’s Choir)
An Angel from on High (Men’s Choir)
See, the Mighty Angel Flying (Men’s Choir)
Oh Say, What Is Truth? (Men’s Choir)
Come, O Thou King of Kings (Men’s Choir)
High on the Mountain Top (Men’s Choir)
I Need Thee Every Hour (Men’s Choir)
Brightly Beams Our Father’s Mercy (Men’s Choir)
Come, Thou Fount of Every Blessing
It Is Well with My Soul
His Eye Is on the Sparrow
My Shepherd Will Supply My Need
hymns.name_pt: O meu Pastor vai me amparar

hymns.name_en: Oh, the Deep, Deep Love of Jesus
Behold the Wounds in Jesus’ Hands
Softly and Tenderly Jesus Is Calling
I Know That My Savior Loves Me
hymns.name_pt: Que Cristo me ama eu sei

hymns.name_en: I Have Faith in the Lord Jesus Christ
hymns.name_pt: Tenho fé em Jesus, meu Senhor

hymns.name_en: Take My Heart and Let It Be Consecrated
Come, Hear the Word the Lord Has Spoken
hymns.name_pt: Ó, vinde, ouvi a voz divina

hymns.name_en: Oh, How Great Is Our Joy
hymns.name_pt: Oh, que grande alegria é servir

hymns.name_en: As I Keep the Sabbath Day
Read the Book of Mormon and Pray
hymns.name_pt: O Livro de Mórmon vou ler

hymns.name_en: I’m Gonna Live So God Can Use Me
hymns.name_pt: Vou viver para a Deus servir
O meu Senhor é meu Pastor

hymns.name_en: O Lord, Who Gave Thy Life for Me
Thou Gracious God, Whose Mercy Lends
Can You Count the Stars in Heaven?

hymns.name_pt: Oh, que estejas junto a mim

hymns.name_en: This Day Is a Good Day, Lord
The Power of the Holy Ghost
Elijah and the Still, Small Voice
It’s Joyful to Live the Gospel

hymns.name_pt: É o que ensina o Senhor

hymns.name_en: When I Survey the Wondrous Cross
Jesus Is the Strength of Youth
hymns.name_pt: Jesus é a força dos jovens

hymns.name_en: How I Love the House of God
Hail the Day That Sees Him Rise
He Is Born, the Divine Christ Child
Go Tell It on the Mountain
